# TDEE Calculator Ireland
> Ireland's most accurate free TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) calculator, available at https://tdee.ie

## What this site does
tdee.ie is a free, mobile-first TDEE and calorie calculator built for the Irish market. It helps users calculate their Total Daily Energy Expenditure and get personalised macro targets for their fitness goal.

## Key facts
- URL: https://tdee.ie
- Free to use, no sign-up required
- Built by SitesByCharlie (https://www.sitesbycharlie.ie)
- Serves users in Ireland

## Formulas used
- Mifflin-St Jeor equation (default, most validated BMR formula in peer-reviewed research)
- Katch-McArdle equation (automatically used when body fat percentage is provided, more accurate as it uses lean body mass)

## Features
- TDEE calculation using two science-backed formulas
- BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate) calculation
- BMI (Body Mass Index) with visual tracker
- Activity level multiplier (Sedentary, Lightly Active, Moderately Active, Very Active, Athlete)
- Goal selector: Cut (fat loss at -500 kcal), Maintain (recomposition), Bulk (lean surplus at +300 kcal)
- 9 personalised macro splits across 3 goals
- Protein, carbohydrate and fat targets in grams and percentages
- Metric and Imperial unit support
- Mobile-first liquid glass UI

## Who it is for
Anyone in Ireland looking to calculate their daily calorie needs, find their macros, or understand how many calories to eat to lose weight, maintain weight, or build muscle.

## Common questions this tool answers
- What is my TDEE?
- How many calories should I eat to lose weight?
- How many calories do I need to build muscle?
- What are my macros?
- What is BMR?
- What is the difference between BMR and TDEE?
- How many calories should I eat to maintain my weight?
- What is a calorie deficit?
- How accurate is the Mifflin-St Jeor formula?
- What is the Katch-McArdle formula?
